test_title: PYST 24: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 07 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: If A + B means that A is the father of B, A × B means that A is the mother of B, A - B means that A is the brother of B then which of the following expression shows that P is the paternal grandmother of R?
solution:
A is

 
 
 

 
 
**Symbol**

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
×

 
 
 
-

 
 
 

 
 
**Meaning**

 
 
 
father

 
 
 
mother

 
 
 
brother

 
 
 

 
 
to B

 
 
 

By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/25ba27fdda33eb0fb4e779a49be1c834b364777f4fda1dc8c44c8a7140b39c25.png] 

1. Q × P + R → Q is mother of P, P is father of R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8aaad0b6ed1e6c337db1c3ad0f900e8ad650c02166f8974683531f348c8987e.png] 

P is father of R.

2. P × Q - R → P is mother of Q, Q is brother of R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e608c28b2afb7b1dcf1b7e2d239db87b40667592e09fd1d44e33356939f3408f.png] 

P is mother of R.

3. P + R × Q → P is father of R, R is mother of Q

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5cdff2f1fbf7f92ecefdae517a66b65894b27cd50855c0c890203694dc7c167d.png] 

P is father of R.

4. P × Q + R → P is mother of Q, Q is father of R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/35546092f580a33d2d1e5357d1131ab1269836e0ac8d890993542fae13b8ba09.png] 

P is the Paternal Grandmother of R.

Hence, ‘**P × Q + R**’ is the correct answer.
